task_description: Replace the fragile session-dependent bare-EC2 benchmark launch that burned ~$353 without producing a single measurement with a self-driving, progressively validated harness. Deliver: a zero-spend preflight gate plus free AWS prerequisites (S3 results bucket, SSM-capable IAM instance profile) and closure of the leftover 0.0.0.0/0 SSH group and unusable key pair; a user-data bootstrap that mounts the 30.4 TB of local NVMe the prior run ignored, guards free space before downloading, streams logs, results and GPU telemetry to S3 and CloudWatch continuously, handles spot interruption, and self-terminates on both completion and a hard wall-clock deadline; a launcher gated behind CONFIRM_SPEND=yes; a stub-based bash test harness so all of that is exercised on a GPU-less sandbox; a staged runner (preflight -> c5d.large plumbing -> g6e.xlarge GPU smoke -> p5en.48xlarge full) with swappable recipe files for the three credible H200 configurations; an S3 checkpoint mirror so retries never re-download 151 GB; a results collector matching the JSON schema compare-results.sh already parses; and documentation (runbook, postmortem, README factual corrections). No EC2 instance is launched and no compute is billed by any feature in this task. FEAT-004 adds the operator-requested stop-and-summarize checkpoint: once a run on H200 or B300 succeeds even once, the staged runner refuses further paid GPU stages until a written summary of that run exists.
spend_policy: The orchestrator has NOT granted approval to launch EC2 capacity. Every feature validates with run-instances --dry-run and the stub harness only. Free, non-compute AWS mutations that ARE authorised: create the S3 results bucket, create the IAM role and instance profile, revoke the SSH 0.0.0.0/0 rule on sg-0775ac013a1b6080d, delete the unusable key pair tpot-bench-key. What a later approved run would cost: p5en.48xlarge spot in us-east-2a at $26.66/hr, bounded by MAX_RUNTIME_MINUTES=240 to about $107 worst case; the optional plumbing stage on c5d.large is a few cents and the gpu-smoke stage on g6e.xlarge is well under a dollar.
